title: Slice-level telemetry + redact-aware span envelopes for streaming API
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Add slice-level (per-chunk/slice) telemetry for the streaming generation path that emits compact, redact-aware span envelopes and a small set of backpressure metrics. This ticket covers instrumentation, a compatibility shim for older SDKs that expect chunk IDs, privacy-aware redaction stamps in traces, and a low-cost sampling policy for high-throughput customers.

Motivation: Current streaming traces and metrics are coarse-grained (request-level). Customers running low-latency chat apps need visibility into per-slice latency, queueing, and downstream tool-call timings. At the same time we must avoid leaking PII in logs/traces and keep telemetry cost predictable at high QPS.

Scope:
- Define and implement a compact span envelope emitted for each output slice with: slice_id, parent_request_id, model_variant, slice_latency_ms, queue_time_ms, token_count, redaction_summary_tag, sampling_flag, and compatibility token for SDKs that use chunk_index.
- Emit backpressure metrics: per-worker slice_queue_depth, per-request burst_count, and client-facing server_push_delay histogram.
- Implement redaction-aware trace tags: integrate with existing redaction service so span envelopes only contain safe metadata and a deterministic redaction-hash for correlation.
- Add a low-overhead sampling policy: deterministic sampling at 0.5% by default plus adaptive sampling based on SLA violations.
- Provide a compatibility layer for older SDKs: map slice_id -> chunk_index when requested and surface chunk_index only to internal telemetry channels (not logs).
- Docs: update Console instrumentation docs and Streaming SDK migration notes.

Non-goals: Full payload capture, long-term storage of slice-level traces, or changing the serving runtime's batching strategy in this ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Span envelope schema v1 is defined and checked into proto definitions and reviewed by Observability team
Instrumentation emits span envelopes for >= 99% of slices under normal load (sampling excluded)
Redaction service integration prevents PII exposure; verified by automated redact tests
Backpressure metrics appear on staging dashboards with sensible cardinality controls
Compatibility shim returns chunk_index for legacy SDK telemetry endpoints without exposing chunk_index in user-visible logs
PRs merged and an accompanying docs PR added to docs/console/streaming-instrumentation.md
tasks: Add emission points in streaming runtime (slice completion + tool-call boundaries)
Hook redact service for span tag generation and add unit tests
Implement sampling policy and feature flag for adaptive sampling
Add metrics (slice_queue_depth, burst_count, server_push_delay) to pushgateway/statsd layer
Build compatibility shim for chunk_index mapping and add SDK tests
Create staging dashboard and alert for queue_depth > threshold
Update Console docs and SDK migration guide
comments: 2025-02-14 | Aisha Patel: Initial write-up and scoping. Proposed deterministic sampling @0.5% to limit cost; adaptive bump for SLA breaches. Asked Observability to review span schema.

2025-02-15 | Marco Ruiz (Observability): Reviewed schema draft. Suggested replacing free-form redaction tags with a fixed enumerated summary (NONE | PARTIAL | FULL) + redaction_hash to avoid cardinality explosion.

2025-02-16 | Priya Mehra (Privacy): Flagged that redaction_hash must be keyed with request salt and rotated monthly. Blocker until redaction-service supports salt rotation; added ENG-61200 as dependency.

2025-02-17 | Liam O'Connor: Implemented proto v1 in a branch. Started hooking emission points. Spike shows ~1.8% CPU overhead at 50k RPS when sampling disabled; keeping sampling default on in feature flag to protect cost.

2025-02-18 | QA: Added test plan for verifying no PII in spans across synthetic payloads and tool-call scenarios. Found one path where tool-call payloads leak tool args into span message; investigation assigned to ENG-56120.

2025-02-20 | Aisha Patel: Decision log: use enumerated redaction_summary + redaction_hash (HMAC with rotating salt). Compatibility shim will only expose chunk_index over internal metrics ingestion path, not in user-facing traces/logs. Moving to In Progress.
